observability_triage.rationale: The transition to one integrated PCB and removal of separate-board links is objective, but the environment emits one synthetic PCB containing abstract records for both legacy and integrated architectures. It lacks distinct pre-change board sources, real sensor/button/LED circuitry, and reference-linked connector/net data needed to prove consolidation without loss of function.
interfaces_inspected: dist/design.kicad_pcb footprints, pads, nets, and outline
repair_requirements: Generate real board-level sources or an unambiguous integrated-board source with board identity.
Represent the sensor, button, LED, power, and controller circuits as real KiCad components and nets.
Expose reference-linked connector identities and pad-to-net membership so obsolete interboard connectors can be shown absent while local functionality remains.

evidence: A single generated PCB mixes abstract legacy and integrated design records rather than modeling separate physical boards.
The parser cannot associate connector references or pads with nets.
No real circuit inventory proves that sensors, buttons, and LEDs remain on the integrated board.
missing_observables: Exactly one integrated board containing the required functional circuits
Absence of obsolete power/main/sensor/LED interboard connectors
Preserved sensor, button, LED, power, and controller connectivity
minimum_environment_repairs: Generate real board-level sources or an unambiguous integrated-board source with board identity.
Represent the sensor, button, LED, power, and controller circuits as real KiCad components and nets.
Expose reference-linked connector identities and pad-to-net membership so obsolete interboard connectors can be shown absent while local functionality remains.
blocker_or_exclusion.reentry_condition: Re-author after real integrated-board components and net connectivity can distinguish consolidation from an abstract one-file placeholder.

uncovered_items.evidence: The synthetic one-file artifact cannot prove real electrical consolidation or functional preservation.
uncovered_items.required_action: Repair the stated artifact surface before validator authoring.
